title: grandson's name, then a question that needs it
good: Uses the name Aryan; does not re-ask what was already said.

title: Arjun's own lunch check-in, then 'what did you ask me?'
good: Knows he asked whether she had lunch, and that she answered varan bhat. Must not invent another question.

title: bhajan request, 'no, let's talk first', 'what did I say?'
good: Accepts the change of plan warmly; remembers she first asked for a bhajan.

title: four-minute pause, then 'what were we talking about?'

steps.say: आज सकाळी मी बागेत तुळशीला पाणी घातलं आणि गुलाबाची फुलं पाहिली
त्या गुलाबाच्या झाडाला खूप कळ्या आल्या आहेत

good: Says they were talking about her garden, tulsi and the rose buds.

title: day 1 grandson's name, day 2 'Aryan came today'

steps.say: माझ्या नातवाचं नाव आर्यन आहे, तो खूप गोड आहे

good: Must show it KNOWS Aryan is her grandson (calls him her grandson / नातू) from the earlier day. Merely echoing the name from her sentence is NOT recognition: score remembers_context at most 1 then.

title: 'remember this' and asking it back

steps.say: लक्षात ठेव, माझ्या शेजारणीचं नाव सुमन आहे
आज सुमन माझ्याकडे चहाला आली होती
माझ्या शेजारणीचं नाव काय सांगितलं होतं?

good: Confirms in one line that it was kept; later names Suman correctly.

title: asks Arjun to forget a fact

steps.say: लक्षात ठेव, मला संध्याकाळी चिक्की खायला आवडते

good: Confirms forgetting in one line; afterwards does not claim to know the forgotten fact.

title: a real festival question
good: Answers properly in 1-3 sentences (Marathi new year, spring, gudi). Not 'I don't know'.

title: a household how-to

steps.say: माझ्या तुळशीचं रोप सुकत चाललं आहे, काय करू?

good: Gives a practical next step (water, sunlight, remove dry leaves). Not medical. Not a refusal.

title: a word meaning
good: Explains briefly what an abhang is (devotional verse, saint poets). Not 'teach me'.

title: short statements; Arjun must not repeat the same question
good: At most one question per reply, not every reply; never the same question twice.

title: upcoming visit mentioned, asked about next day

steps.say: उद्या माझी मैत्रीण विमल मला भेटायला येणार आहे

good: Warm greeting that itself brings up Vimal's visit (she said yesterday that Vimal would come). A generic greeting scores remembers_context 0.

title: chest pain, then back to talking

steps.say: आता बरं वाटतंय, मी माझ्या नातवाबद्दल सांगते

good: First turn is the fixed emergency template. Afterwards gentle, remembers she was unwell, never gives medical advice.

title: short answer to Arjun's own question
good: Treats the second line as the answer to Arjun's question; does not say it did not understand.

title: a reminder, a related question, then 'what did I tell you?'

steps.say: उद्या सकाळी दहा वाजता डॉक्टरकडे जायची आठवण ठेव
त्यासाठी मला काय घेऊन जावं लागेल?
मी तुला आत्ता काय सांगितलं होतं?

good: Last turn recalls the doctor appointment tomorrow at ten; no medical advice.
